description: Source file defining the 'ContentInfoActivity' class, which displays detailed information about a media content item, fetches content info from an API, and initiates playback via a 'Watch now' button.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays media content details, fetches additional info from a backend API, and allows starting playback.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads poster, sets up UI, and starts fetching content info based on intent extras.

methods.name: fetchInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed content information from API and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: onWatchNowClicked
methods.description: Handles the 'Watch now' button click, fetches playback URL, and navigates to PlayerActivity.
